title.en: Stay on one row while resolving which building pump prints an 80 mm delivery pipe
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：哪一台建筑泵印了 80 mm 输送管

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Electric 20. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the delivery pipe diameter as 80 mm on that building and commercial model, together with aggregate 1–2 cm, 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa and 120 m / 40 m. Keep this cell as published. HBT80-16 and HBT8018 print 100 / 125 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm on the compact rural row. Read it in the Xingtai table. An 80 mm line is an Electric 20 question.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：电动20。邢台河北品锦机械在这台建筑与商业型号上把输送管内径印成 80 mm，同时是骨料 1–2 cm、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa 和 120 m / 40 m。HBT80-16 和 HBT8018 印的是 100 / 125 mm。电动15在紧凑农村行上印的是 100–125 mm。80 mm 管路是电动20的问题。

directAnswer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：电动20。邢台河北品锦机械在这台建筑与商业型号上把输送管内径印成 80 mm，同时是骨料 1–2 cm、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa 和 120 m / 40 m。HBT80-16 和 HBT8018 印的是 100 / 125 mm。电动15在紧凑农村行上印的是 100–125 mm。80 mm 管路是电动20的问题。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Imperial units” in “Pipe Velocity Calculator with Flow Data & Charts”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Electric 20 prints 80 mm, with 1–2 cm aggregate, 120 m / 40 m and 8–10 m³/h. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the delivery pipe diameter as 80 mm on that building and commercial model, together with aggregate 1–2 cm, 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa and 120 m / 40 m. Keep this cell as published. An 80 mm line is an Electric 20 question. Taken from the printed row: The frame is 900 kg, smaller than the 2300 kg Electric 40, which does not print 80 mm in its specification list. Read it in the Xingtai table. This application note only says which pump prints 80 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. If you do not, ask whether 80 mm and 1–2 cm stone match the pour. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Taken from the printed row: The DN80 clamp is a spare-part page. Read it in the Xingtai table. This page does not authorise a larger stone. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pipe-velocity-d_1096.html
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Pipe Velocity Calculator with Flow Data & Charts》的“英制单位”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：电动20印了 80 mm，骨料 1–2 cm，距离 120 m / 40 m，输送量 8–10 m³/h。不要把这个管径抄到电动30或 HBT80-16 上。旁边那一台不在这句话里。直管、胶管、弯头和管卡页面是配件。它们在泵型号确定后报价。这篇应用说明只说哪一台泵印了 80 mm。它不是配件清单，也不规定长度或价格。这一格照已印出的读：不是。这里引用的表里，只有电动20印了 80 mm。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pipe-velocity-d_1096.html

body.en: “Pipe Velocity Calculator with Flow Data & Charts” breaks its subject at “SI units”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Do not copy that diameter onto Electric 30 or HBT80-16. Read it in the Xingtai table. HBT80-16 and HBT8018 print 100 / 125 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The same Electric 20 row limits aggregate to 1–2 cm. Keep this cell as published. Straight delivery pipe, hose, elbow and clamp pages are spare parts. Taken from the printed row: It is not a parts list and it does not set a length or a price. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. It is not proof that every pump is an Electric 20.
body.zh: 《Pipe Velocity Calculator with Flow Data & Charts》在“国际单位单位”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。电动20。河北品锦机械（邢台）在这台建筑与商业型号上把输送管内径印成 80 mm，同时是骨料 1–2 cm、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa 和 120 m / 40 m。HBT80-16 和 HBT8018 印的是 100 / 125 mm。电动15在紧凑农村行上印的是 100–125 mm。80 mm 管路是电动20的问题。按邢台表上的原文理解：如果已有管子，请写管径。如果没有，就问 80 mm 和 1–2 cm 石子是否对得上这次浇筑。旁边那一台不在这句话里。DN80 管卡是配件页。它不能证明每台泵都是电动20。

heading.en: Example - Flow Velocity in a Steel Pipe

body.en: Borrow “Example - Flow Velocity in a Steel Pipe” from “Pipe Velocity Calculator with Flow Data & Charts” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Electric 20. Taken from the printed row: Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm on the compact rural row. Read it in the Xingtai table. A mix that needs the 1–3 cm window of Electric 15, or the ≤ 3 cm window of Electric 30, is not automatically an 80 mm Electric 20 job. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. They are quoted after the pump model is known. Keep this cell as published. If you already own pipe, say the diameter. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. Only Electric 20 prints 80 mm in the tables cited here. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The published aggregate cell is 1–2 cm.
body.zh: 把《Pipe Velocity Calculator with Flow Data & Charts》的“例子流量速度钢管道”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：同一行电动20把骨料限在 1–2 cm。需要电动15那种 1–3 cm 窗口，或电动30那种 ≤ 3 cm 窗口的料，不会自动变成 80 mm 的电动20工况。机重 900 kg，小于 2300 kg 的电动40。电动40的规格表没有印 80 mm。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。按邢台表上的原文理解：已公布的骨料格是 1–2 cm。本页不批准更大的石子。

question.en: “Imperial units” does not change the check: Does every building pump use 80 mm?
question.zh: “英制单位”不改这一问：每台建筑泵都用 80 mm 吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Only Electric 20 prints 80 mm in the tables cited here.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。这里引用的表里，只有电动20印了 80 mm。

question.en: Is DN80 clamp the same statement, once the outline says “SI units”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“国际单位单位”时，DN80 管卡是同一句话吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The DN80 clamp is a spare-part page. It is not proof that every pump is an Electric 20.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：DN80 管卡是配件页。它不能证明每台泵都是电动20。

question.en: Under “Example - Flow Velocity in a Steel Pipe”, can Electric 20 take 4 cm stone if the pipe is changed?
question.zh: 在“例子流量速度钢管道”这一节里，换了管子，电动20能打 4 cm 石子吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. The published aggregate cell is 1–2 cm. This page does not authorise a larger stone.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：已公布的骨料格是 1–2 cm。本页不批准更大的石子。
